text: it is my humble request to konami to fix the network server issue. even with 5g, you'll be thrown out of the match, not only that, it's not an unfinished match but will be counted as a loss with heavy minus points, I've changed 3 wifi connections , still the same issue persists, every season I loose 10 to 15 matches straight because of network. not even let me play the match, just matched and then loose due to poor connection. The gameplay mechanics are really good and feel realistic. However, with every other update, the game will feel sluggish, game mechanics will get broken and the matches start to get scripted. Connection tends to be limited to 3 bars which causes issues in division matches. Best to stick with friend matches, you can't really have a single week of the game running well until an update ruins it.

The game was good at first. The graphics are ok. the gameplay lacks clarity at a certain level. But the worst of the worst are the pack openings. If it is a reward, it is okay, I understand if I don't get a good player but when you are spending thousands and not getting anything, that's where the thing becomes a scam. If there is an arbitrary system going on for distributing epic or high level players, why bother for so much glamour? why bother keeping in game purchases? This is a SCAM.

Your game is absolutely amazing and, in my opinion, the most realistic football game available. The gameplay, graphics, player movements, and overall football experience are outstanding. However, there is one issue that many players would love to see improved. The actual match duration feels too short. Half-time arrives very quickly, and the match ends before players can fully enjoy the game and build realistic attacks. It would be great if you could add a custom match time option in the General

The gameplay is fun, but please fix the **Fixed Analog**—it feels laggy and inconsistent. Reduce input delay and improve server stability, as online matches often lag even on a stable connection. Let us choose AI difficulty in Training mode. Add a goal limit option in Custom Matches (first to 3, 5, 10, etc.). Also, kickoff after a goal feels unfair, as the attacking team can often score again before defenders can react. FIX ALL THIS and I WILL GIVE A 5 STAR RATING.

Overall, it ends up feeling more annoying than enjoyable, and definitely needs major improvements.

It's a brilliant game overall, not gonna lie. From the commentary to the graphics to the in-game physics etc. I feel it's currently better than almost every football game available right now. My only concern is that Pay-to-Win players spend lots of money on Epic, Epic Showtime and Big Time cards that feel broken in game and Free-to-Win players can't really do anything about these stat-boosted cards. So KONAMI, if you are seeing this, atleast do something to balance the power dynamic.

One of the best football games ever — easy 5 stars! It would be even better with a player career mode: create a customizable player with limited progression, start at smaller clubs, earn points by playing, and attract bigger clubs over time—just like real life. It would also be great to have an offline mode, with automatic updates when back online.

I have loved football since childhood, which is why I installed this game. However, I have one issue with the controls. The dash button is used for running, dashing, and now also for dribbling. This new addition is very irritating during important moments. When I try to pass or run with the ball, the unnecessary dribbling gives the opponent a chance to score. Please add a separate dribble button, or remove the dribbling function from the dash button.

its a realistic game and so good. But i think it's scripted. eFootball is a mess! The gameplay's cloppy, the graphics are meh, and don't even get me started on the bugs. Players get stuck, goals are unfairly disallowed, and the AI's like it's playing a different game. Updates are few and far between, and the 'free-to-play' model's just a cash grab. I have been playing eFootball for some time, and I really like the game. The gameplay feels smooth and realistic especially the player movement and passing. It is fun and enjoyable to play, and I can see the effort put into making it better. However I think the game can improve more. Overall, it is a very good game.

The graphics in the game are great. However, whenever I try to play online with random players (real humans), the game starts to lag. I don't think it's due to my device or processor—it's likely a network issue. I haven't been able to play a single online match without lag so far. Every match I've tried gets interrupted in the middle, and I receive a message saying the opponent has network issues. But this happens in every match? It's really frustrating. Please look into this and fix it ASAP.

my review of the game. While I really enjoy the overall graphics and mechanics, I have noticed a significant difference between the AI and PVP modes. When I play PVP matches, the experience is not as enjoyable as playing against the AI. In PVP, the passing, shooting, and through balls often feel inconsistent or delayed. However, in AI mode, the passing, shooting, and through balls are much more accurate and responsive. I hope you can improve the PVP gameplay to make it as smooth as the AI mode.

Dear KONAMI, I want to complain about the current Match Up system in eFootball. It has become too powerful compared to Pressure style. Players using Match Up can block almost every pass and movement too easily, making defending feel automatic instead of skill-based. Football should reward timing, positioning, and control. Please reduce the strength of Match Up and make defending more balanced. We want every play style to have a fair chance. If this continues, many players may lose interest.

Gotta be honest with myself and everyone here, this is a must have app in my smartphone. Have been there for many years, through several smartphone changes. This is a must have. I also enjoy playing it in video games, the first one was Winning Eleven and this is a more modern form of it. The game is very simple and up to now the game has very impressive visual effect and close-to-real moves. I like the controls, much better than FIFA. I love collecting the players even it's a gacha style. I appreciate them to provide these players without the need for us to purchase with real money, even it's a long winding road to get it. Okay, I might be bitchin' here but here is the thing, the higher the difficulty is, I kinda feel that not only the enemy is more difficult (well d'oh, it's supposed to be) but it also make me (my team) looks like idiot, they run slower, lack response with my controls, and so on. I don't know but I think it's the system intentionally do this to facilitate the difficulty range. 2. The UI/UX, okay it's already good but definitely can be better. In the previous season, you can actually go back to the main menu with one touch button from the match page or something, but now you need to go back every step off the way. Not all things are accessible which I think they should. What I meant is that some things like training a player should be accessible from the squad management. And players should be able to sort player from their names or nationality; because, 3. I like to make custom teams based on favorites, as well as based on nationals or clubs. But the squad amount is limited, hopefully they can make this unlimited. 4. In previous seasons, you can use specific player to train the same player better compared to other players. Why they remove this? Now there is a trade feature where you can trade 3 of the same players with another, this is fun. But not only it has to be the same player, but also must be the same version / category. This is frustrating to me. For instance, Messi, there are 4 or more different version / category for him. Not sure which one is the best. I get it with different version, but seriously 2 are more than enough. 5. Please increase the player limit more than 500? I want to collect them all (like them Pokemons). Unlimited is better. 6. I started the game with Borrusia Dortmund in previous season, why the club is no longer available? So I chose Lazio and then I bought the team Arsenal. This changed my team to Arsenal, no Lazio no more, why this? Should my team purchase is an option to shuffle between teams? What happened then if I bought Man Utd after Arsenal? Will Arsenal be replaced by Man Utd?

The best soccer game ever played, the graphics is the best, the controls are easy, you can even edit the control to your choice, less lags and bugs, team build is massive.
